meta.title: Moments
meta.description: A native-feeling local notes workspace with quick capture, tags, search, review, images, backup and a thirty-day trash.

empty.workspaceTitle: This workspace is empty so far
empty.workspaceHint: Everything you write is saved in this workspace. Add #tags as you type to file a note, and #tags/subtags to nest it.
empty.filteredHint: The keyword, the date range and the tag all narrow the same timeline — drop one and the rest comes back.
empty.reviewEmptyHint: A review draws from notes you have already written. Add a few and they will come back at random.
empty.onThisDayEmptyTitle: No notes from this day in past years
empty.onThisDayEmptyHint: Nothing was written on this date in an earlier year — keep writing, and next year this day will bring a surprise.
